(WebFetch — Irish Times live updates, 20 July 2026)

Ministers seen entering No 10: Ed Miliband (Energy Secretary under Starmer), Shabana
Mahmood (Home Secretary under Starmer; described as favourite for Chancellor), John Healey
(resigned as Defence Secretary under Starmer last month), Louise Haigh (former Transport
Secretary).

Removed from cabinet ("sacked or resigned"): Rachel Reeves (Chancellor of the Exchequer),
David Lammy (Deputy Prime Minister), Peter Kyle (Business Secretary), Steve Reed (Housing
Secretary), Liz Kendall (Science and Technology Secretary).

Burnham inaugural speech: "We have not been good enough and we need to be better. We will
be." Committed to announcing "help with the cost of living" and ending rough sleeping as
first priorities.

David Lammy (departing): said it was "the greatest privilege of my life" to serve in
Starmer's government.
